question: What measures determine the linga section and its middle portion?
premises: The linga measure is specified as one part.
The middle portion is specified by its own part measure.
The practitioner is instructed to arrange these elements.
inference: The linga section should be arranged as one part with the middle portion set accordingly.
uncertainties: The precise value of the middle part relative to the whole is not fully specified.
plain_english: One should arrange the linga measure as one part and set its middle portion by that part.
